notes: Iceland (64.9°N), Norway (60.5°N), Finland (61.9°N) — high-latitude northern Europe. In Mercator these points are near the top of the visible SVG band, leaving little room for callouts above. Tests top-edge pressure.

callouts.headline: Iceland volcanic eruption
callouts.detail: A fissure eruption on the Reykjanes peninsula forces evacuation of nearby geothermal infrastructure.

callouts.headline: Norway sovereign wealth fund record
callouts.detail: Norway's Government Pension Fund Global hits a new all-time high in assets under management.

callouts.headline: Finland NATO exercise begins
callouts.detail: Finland hosts its first major NATO joint exercise since joining the alliance.
